description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.
The region ID of the service instance.

description.zh:
服务实例ID。

您可以通过调用[ListServiceInstances - 查询服务实例列表](~~396200~~)获取服务实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the service instance.

Call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to get the service instance ID.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请您确保在创建服务时添加了重启的运维操作。具体操作，请参见[创建服务](~~440268~~)。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Ensure that you add the restart Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) operation when you create the service. For more information, see [Create a service](~~440268~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier restart-service-instance --client-token 10CM943JP0EN90000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4b170000 --region cn-hangzhou
